metadata.title: Kṛt Pratyayas and Their Pāṇinian Meanings — Most Extensive Reference (Aṣṭādhyāyī Adhyāya 3 & Siddhānta Kaumudī 65, 66, 68)
authority_sources: Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita — Siddhānta Kaumudī: 65. कृत्यप्रकरणम् (https://ashtadhyayi.com/kaumudi/65), 66. पूर्वकृदन्तप्रकरणम् (https://ashtadhyayi.com/kaumudi/66), 68. उत्तरकृदन्तप्रकरणम् (https://ashtadhyayi.com/kaumudi/68)

governing_sutras.role: Adhikāra (3.1.91–3.4.117): All suffixes introduced here attach directly after a verb root (dhātu).
Saṃjñā: Any pratyaya introduced under 3.1.91 that is not a finite verb ending (tiṅ) is called kṛt.
Paribhāṣā: Except in the striyām section (3.3.94+), a non-homophonous apavāda optionally blocks its utsarga.
Adhikāra (3.1.95–3.1.132): Defines the 7-suffix Kṛtya sub-domain before ṇvultṛcau.
Default Kāraka: Unless specified otherwise, a kṛt pratyaya denotes the agent (kartṛ).
Kāraka Override: Kṛtya, kta, and khalartha suffixes denote only bhāva (action) or karma (object).
Saṃjñā: Tiṅ and śit kṛt suffixes are sārvadhātuka.
Saṃjñā: All remaining kṛt suffixes (non-śit) are ārdhadhātuka.

bhava_and_karma.label: Bhāva & Karma (Abstract Action & Object)

kala.label: Kāla (Tense / Time)
kala.description: Suffixes anchored to past, present, or future time.

avyaya_sambandha.label: Avyaya / Sambandha (Indeclinable Relations)

krt_natva_8_4_29_to_34.effect: n -> ṇ in a kṛt suffix after a vowel when preceded by r/ṣ in an upasarga (e.g., प्रयाणीयम्).
Optional ṇatva in kṛt after ṇyanta (प्रयापणीयम् / प्रयापनीयम्).
Optional ṇatva after consonant-initial roots with penultimate ic (प्रकोपणीयम् / प्रकोपनीयम्).
Mandatory ṇatva after ic-initial roots taking num (प्रेङ्खणीयम्).
Optional ṇatva for niṃs, nikṣ, nind (प्रणिंसितव्यम् / प्रनिंसितव्यम्).
Prohibits ṇatva for bhā, bhū, pū, kam, gam, pyāyī, vep (प्रभानीयम्, प्रभवनीयम्).

kutva_7_3_52_to_62.effect: c/j -> k/g before gh-it and ṇyat (पाकः, त्यागः, पाक्यम्, मार्ग्यः).
Blocks kutva for aj and vraj (समाजः, परिव्राजः).

adhikara_hierarchy.scope: Macro-domain: attaches to a verb root (dhātu).
Kṛt domain: non-tiṅ suffixes after a dhātu.

ya_suffix_decision_tree.condition: Lexical exception list (e.g., i, stu, śās, vṛ, dṛ, juṣ; vad/bhū/han with supi; ṛ-upadha roots excluding kḷp/cṛt; bhṛñ asaṃjñāyām; mṛj optionally).
Vowel-ending roots (ajanta) excluding ṛ/ṝ; plus labial-ending short-a roots (3.1.98), śak/sah (3.1.99), gad/mad/car/yam anupasarge (3.1.100).
